evidence.reason: Line 177 substitutes the escaped instance for both specifiers. In systemd, `%i` is the escaped instance but `%I` is the unescaped instance, so `ingress@crq\x2dtick.socket` with `Service=%I.service` must resolve to `crq-tick.service`. The current code produces `crq\x2dtick.service` and can miss the CRQ dependency. The smallest fix is to apply unit-name unescaping only when replacing `%I`, leaving `%i` unchanged.
